from __future__ import annotations
import dataclasses
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

def deny_resources(event, args):
    if event in {"socket.connect", "socket.getaddrinfo", "subprocess.Popen"}:
        raise RuntimeError("resource operation prohibited in this observer")
    if event == "import" and args[0].split(".")[0] in {
        "torch", "transformers", "vllm", "huggingface_hub", "numpy"
    }:
        raise RuntimeError("heavy model import prohibited in this observer")

sys.addaudithook(deny_resources)
from reprollm.core.context import AuditContext
from reprollm.core.deps import (
    Declarations, _RequirementInclude, _RequirementsGraph, scan_dependencies,
)
from reprollm.core.git import GitInfo
from reprollm.core.scanner import RepoScanner
from reprollm.rules.env import LlmCriticalDepsPinnedRule, LockfilePresentRule

def observe(case, workspace):
    root = workspace / case["id"]
    root.mkdir()
    for rel, text in sorted(case["inputs"].items()):
        path = root / rel
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(text.encode("utf-8"))
    scanner = RepoScanner(root, GitInfo(is_repo=False))
    deps = scan_dependencies(scanner)
    ctx = AuditContext(root)
    ctx._git = GitInfo(is_repo=False)
    ctx._fs = scanner
    ctx._deps = deps
    critical = LlmCriticalDepsPinnedRule()
    presence = LockfilePresentRule()
    with patch("reprollm.rules.env.installed_versions", return_value={}):
        findings = critical.check(ctx) if critical.applies(ctx) else []
        present_findings = presence.check(ctx) if presence.applies(ctx) else []
    graph = _RequirementsGraph(scanner, Declarations())
    roots = sorted(p for p in scanner.analysis_files()
                   if Path(p).name.startswith("requirements") and p.endswith(".txt"))
    graph.parse(roots)
    return {
        "analysis_files": scanner.analysis_files(),
        "manifest_present": deps.manifest_present,
        "declarations": [dataclasses.asdict(d) for d in deps.declarations],
        "imports": [dataclasses.asdict(i) for i in ctx.pyscan.imports],
        "unparsed": deps.unparsed,
        "lockfiles": [{"path": item.path, "packages": sorted(item.packages)}
                      for item in deps.lockfiles],
        "requirements_graph": {
            "roots": roots,
            "edges": [{"source": source, **dataclasses.asdict(event)}
                      for source, node in sorted(graph.nodes.items())
                      for event in node.events if isinstance(event, _RequirementInclude)],
            "closures": [{"root": source, "complete": c.complete,
                          "is_exact": c.is_exact, "sources": sorted(c.sources),
                          "packages": sorted(c.packages)}
                         for source, c in sorted(graph.closures.items())],
        },
        "critical_in_use": critical._critical_in_use(ctx),
        "critical_rule_applies": critical.applies(ctx),
        "critical_findings": [f.model_dump(mode="json") for f in findings],
        "lock_presence_rule_applies": presence.applies(ctx),
        "lock_presence_findings": [f.model_dump(mode="json") for f in present_findings],
    }

def replay(document, workspace):
    if "sources" in document:
        import reprollm
        expected_module = Path.cwd() / "src/reprollm/__init__.py"
        if Path(reprollm.__file__).resolve() != expected_module.resolve():
            raise AssertionError("observer must import the intended checkout")
        for source in document["sources"]:
            raw = (Path.cwd() / source["path"]).read_bytes()
            if len(raw) != source["bytes"] or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != source["sha256"]:
                raise AssertionError("source inventory mismatch: " + source["path"])
    rows = []
    for case in document["cases"]:
        observed = observe(case, workspace)
        expected = case.get("observation")
        if expected is not None and observed != expected:
            raise AssertionError("observation mismatch: " + case["id"])
        rows.append({"id": case["id"], "observation": observed})
    return rows

if __name__ == "__main__":
    document = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    workspace = Path(sys.argv[2])
    workspace.mkdir(parents=False, exist_ok=False)
    rows = replay(document, workspace)
    print(json.dumps({"schema_version": 1, "cases_compared": len(rows),
                      "result": "MATCHED_CURRENT_OBSERVATIONS"}, sort_keys=True))
